data.long_meaning: Variant spelling of Arabic ʿāʾida (عائدة), the feminine active participle of ʿāda 'to return', from the root ʿ-w-d. aaidah therefore means “Returning; visitor; benefit; advantage”. Arabic feminine active participle ʿāʾida 'returning; benefit'; spelling variant of Aaida.
data.spiritual_meaning: aaidah expresses “Guide, Symbol, Sign”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Variant spelling of Arabic ʿāʾida (عائدة), the feminine active participle of ʿāda 'to return', from the root ʿ-w-d.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of aaidah total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

faq.q: Is Aaidah the same name as Aaida?
faq.a: Yes - Aaidah and Aaida are two English spellings of the same Arabic name عائدة, meaning 'returning; benefit'.

faq.q: What does the name aaidah mean?
Where does the name aaidah come from?
What is the linguistic root of aaidah?
faq.a: The root of aaidah is ع-و-د (ʿ-w-d).

faq.q: How is aaidah written in Arabic script?
faq.a: aaidah is written عائدة in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is aaidah a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: aaidah is used as a female name.

faq.q: Does aaidah appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. aaidah is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of aaidah verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Returning; visitor; benefit; advantage” is established by Arabic feminine active participle ʿāʾida 'returning; benefit'; spelling variant of Aaida..
